eyebrow.zh: 信创气隙 · 重启即恢复 · 无需重算
eyebrow.en: Air-gap · Resume on Restart · No Recompute

headline.zh:
百万 token KV 缓存
重启即恢复
headline.en:
Million-token KV cache
Resumes on restart

sub.zh: 信创气隙下 GLM-5.3 重启即丢 80GB 注意力状态？KVSnap 落盘保存、秒级恢复，跳过数小时 prefill 重算。
sub.en: GLM-5.3 loses its 80GB+ attention state on every restart in an air-gap? KVSnap checkpoints to disk and restores in seconds, skipping hours of prefill recompute.

title.zh: 落盘保存百万 token KV 缓存

body.zh: 一条命令把 GLM-5.3 的整段注意力状态写入磁盘——自描述格式、每层 K/V 张量逐字节落盘，重启后原样注入新引擎。
body.en: One command writes GLM-5.3's entire attention state to disk — a self-describing format with per-layer K/V tensors serialized byte-for-byte, injected back into a fresh engine on restart.

title.zh: 重启秒级恢复，跳过 prefill

body.zh: 重启后按同一格式注入新引擎，跳过整段 prefill。气隙下无云端兜底时，数十分钟的重算变秒级恢复。
body.en: After restart, inject the same bytes back into the fresh engine, skipping the entire prefill. Without cloud fallback in an air-gap, tens of minutes of recompute become seconds.

chips: › 昇腾 / 海光 GPU 适配

title.zh: 落盘即校验，篡改即拦截

body.zh: 每个 blob 写入时计算 xxhash64，恢复前重算校验——磁盘错误、截断写入或被篡改的 blob 在进引擎前就被拦下。
body.en: Every blob gets an xxhash64 on write, recomputed before restore — a torn write, disk error, or tampered blob is caught before it reaches the engine.

title.zh: 信创气隙专用，数据不出境
title.en: Built for 信创 air-gap, data stays local

body.zh: 离线 wheel 安装、无云端依赖、无外部服务调用。从落盘到恢复，全链路在气隙机房内完成。
body.en: Offline wheel install, no cloud dependency, no external service calls. From checkpoint to restore, the entire pipeline stays inside the air-gapped machine room.

chips: › 数据安全法 / 等保 2.0 合规

headline.zh: 重启即丢上下文的时代结束了
headline.en: The era of losing context on restart is over

sub.zh: 三条命令验证整个落盘→校验→恢复链路，离线即可运行。
sub.en: Three commands verify the entire checkpoint→verify→restore pipeline, runnable offline.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 信创气隙专用
